    Public Hearing and Regular Meeting

    Community Board 4 (the full board) meets on the third Wednesday of the month from September to June at 6pm in the Hope Gardens Older Adult Center at 195 Linden Street and via Zoom (registration required to participate virtually). The board is on recess during July and August. At these meetings, board members address items of concern to the community. Board meetings are open to the public and a portion of each meeting is reserved for the Board to hear from members of the public. See the public hearing and regular meeting newsletter below.

    Committee Meetings

    The Board currently has six committees, including:

    • Arts/Culture/Technology + Youth and Education
    • Civic/Public Safety/Religious + Health/Human Service/Senior Citizens/Veterans
    • District Office
    • Economic Development + Housing and Land Use
    • Environmental Protection/Transportation/Sanitation + Parks and Recreation
    • Permits and Licenses.

    Some committees meet more often than others may convene during the summer recess with support from a majority of committee members. For more information, please check the board's calendar or contact the District Office at bk04@cb.nyc.gov.

    Learn more about CB4's Committees

    District Service Cabinet Meetings

    Community Board 4 also hosts a District Service Cabinet meeting on the second Wednesday of the month at 10:30am. Agency liaisons and elected officials/their representatives are invited to share updates and important announcements. The District Manager similarly reports on any issues that need additional attention from city agencies and/or local elected officials.


    Public Hearing and Regular Meeting Newsletter

    Email submission requests to bk04@cb.nyc.gov. The submission request deadline is the second Tuesday of the month. The newsletter is sent generally a week in advance of the public hearing and regular meeting (full board) during the board meeting year from September to June. If the office is short-staffed, it may affect the usual schedule.
